entries.notes: Data compromise endorsement (response expenses plus defense and liability) that attaches to a commercial property or package policy. Uploaded July 2023. The spelling 'Defence' suggests it may be Canadian, but the country is unverified.

entries.title: Data Compromise Coverage

entries.title: Businessowners Policy Declarations
entries.notes: Sample BOP declarations from Chubb, found by a search for 'data compromise' BOP endorsements. It probably schedules optional cyber, data compromise or electronic data coverages on the BOP. Not verified.

entries.title: BUSINESSOWNER'S COVERAGE FORM INDEX
entries.notes: OLDER (2010). GUARD BOP coverage form with index, found in a data compromise search. Its cyber content is probably limited to electronic data and computer provisions in the base BOP form.

entries.title: BUSINESSOWNERS BP 00 03 01 06
entries.notes: OLDER (01/06 edition). The base ISO BOP coverage form includes the Electronic Data and Interruption of Computer Operations additional coverages. It is the base form that ISO data compromise and cyber endorsements attach to.

entries.product: Master Pac / Pac Plus (Select Accounts small business package)

entries.title: SELECT ACCOUNTS | SMALL BUSINESS - Building Businessowners
entries.notes: Travelers BOP product sheet (agency-hosted). Lists key and optional coverages that may include cyber and data add-ons.

entries.title: Travelers Store Businessowners Policy
entries.notes: Offers an optional 'Denial of Service Attack - Time Element' enhancement: business income and extra expense when e-commerce computer operations are suspended by a denial-of-service attack. The enhancement attaches to the BOP.

entries.title: OFFICE PAC A Custom Insurance Policy Prepared for: Presented by:
entries.notes: An issued Travelers Office Pac package proposal or policy, posted publicly by a nonprofit insured. It came up in a search for Travelers BOP cyber endorsements and may include data, cyber or electronic data endorsements. Whether it contains cyber endorsements is unverified.

entries.product: CyberRisk (standalone, or as a coverage part in Wrap+ for private and nonprofit organizations and in Executive Choice+)

entries.notes: Travelers forms library for CyberRisk. CyberRisk is sold through the Wrap+ (private and nonprofit) and Executive Choice+ platforms. The short-form application is limited to revenue of $50M or less and assets of $500M or less (the SMB tier).

entries.title: Travelers CYB-16001-CW
entries.notes: Countrywide CyberRisk form. The snippets mention Social Engineering Fraud, Computer Fraud and Business Interruption from a Security Breach. It can be written standalone or within Wrap+ and Executive Choice+.
